ADC_PAGE_ITEMS

Table to store all page items of the referenced page.

Columns
cpi_crg_id

FK, reference to ADC_RULE_GROUP

cpi_id

PK, technical key

cpi_cpit_id

FK, reference to ADC_PAGE_ITEM_TYPE

cpi_label

Item label

cpi_conversion

Conversion pattern to convert item value to required data type

cpi_item_default

Optional default value as entered in APEX

cpi_css

CSS classes per page item as entered in APEX

cpi_is_required

Flag to indicate whether rule conditions reference this item and therefore must be bound by ADC

cpi_is_mandatory

Flag to indicate whether item is mandatory and must be checked prior to submit

cpi_mandatory_message

Message emitted if this element is null

cpi_validation_method

Optional PL/SQL call to a validation method

cpi_may_have_value

Flag to indicate whether the page item may contain a session state value

cpi_form_region_id

Optional static ID of the form region a page item belongs to

cpi_has_error

Flag to indicate whether actions reference non-existent page items

References
cpi_cpit_id

references ADC_PAGE_ITEM_TYPES (cpit_id)

cpi_crg_id

references ADC_RULE_GROUPS (crg_id)

cpi_caat_id

references ADC_APEX_ACTION_TYPES (caat_id)
